newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded prices drift lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded prices drift lower.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline prices drifted lower late Friday, tracking easing NYMEX futures prices on steady differentials in thin trade, traders said.
High sulphur diesel differentials held onto strength generated earlier in the day from higher Gulf Coast prices and emerging agricultural demand in the Group Three region, traders said.
Unleaded prices ended a volatile week that saw differentials swing widely in response to the print and a draw in gasoline stocks pegged to Chicago refineries.

Chicago unleaded was talked 0.25 cent a gallon over the print for prompt April deliveries, with later deliveries bid even with the print. Group Three unleaded was bids 2.0 cents a gallon under the print for all April timings.
Low sulphur diesel was talked unchanged at 4.25/4.50 cents a gallon over the print in Chicago and 5.25/5.50 cents over in Group Three, traders said.

High sulphur diesel also was steady at 1.75/2.0 cents a gallon over May NYMEX heating oil in Chicago and 4.75/5.0 cents a gallon over the print in Group Three, where agricultural demand pushed prices higher on the day.
